## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **provenance record** | `{origin, authority, taint = ∅, readers = Public, scope, derived_from = [], created_at, attestation?}` on every HIR node/edge and every content-bearing ledger event; excluded from `semantic_id`, included in `version_id`. | WS-L3 (extends WS-A3's slot); C0 |
| **authority class** | Closed total order `kernel > definition > principal > delegate > environment > external > unverified` answering "how much may this item command the harness"; join = min. Never an evidence weight. | WS-L3; answers OQ-054; values frozen per HIR dialect |
| **label** | The triple `(authority, taint, readers)` with `⊑` = (≥, ⊆, ⊇), join = (min, ∪, ∩), meet = (max, ∩, ∪); top `(kernel, ∅, Public)`, bottom `(unverified, U, ∅)`. | WS-L3 / WS-H2; product of Fides' lattices with CaMeL's sources |
| **taint set** / **taint tag** | The set of origin references at class ≤ `external` that influenced an item; a tag is a tool + inner source, a participant, or an import source; join = union; `taint ≠ ∅ ⇒ authority ≤ external`. | WS-L3 / WS-H2; C2 enforcement |
| **reader set** | `Public | set<PrincipalRef>`: who may see an item; join = intersection with `Public` as identity. | WS-L3 / WS-H2 / WS-H3; C2 |
| **persistence scope** | `{definition, user, project, session, run, turn}`: where an item lives; distinct from authority; each scope has a write ceiling. | WS-L3 / WS-D4 / WS-H1; precedent Claude SDK setting sources, S-103 σ |
| **context label** | Per model call, the join of the labels of every delivered item; stamped on `context.assembled`; recomputed per call; lowered by delivery, raised only by isolation or endorsement. | WS-L3 / WS-D1 / WS-H1; Fides `current_label`, Biba low-water mark |
| **effective authority (of a proposal)** | `min(authority(proposer), context_label.authority)` with taint = `taint(context_label) ∪ taint(args)`; the quantity the reference monitor decides on. | WS-L3 / WS-H1 |
| **endorsement** / **declassification** / **endorsement point** / **endorsement basis** | The only label increases; each is a ledger event with an endorser whose class ≥ the target and a basis from the closed list `{seal, approval, validator, promotion, pin, policy_rule}`; declassification widens readers only. | WS-L3 / WS-H1 / WS-H2 / WS-H5 / WS-D4; DLM/Flume |
| **narrow-or-preserve** | The propagation discipline: derivation, delegation, persistence and lowering may only preserve or lower a label; widening exists only at endorsement points. | WS-L3; doc 2 §5.6 |
| **role-placement invariant** / **role map** | The compiler renders an item only into a provider role whose privilege ≤ `role_map(authority(item))`; `role_map` is a Model Profile surface; below-slot items are rejected or demoted, never promoted. | WS-L3 / WS-D1 / WS-A4 / WS-C3; closes M-CPE |
| **authority-before-relevance** | The retrieval contract order: validity → authority → readers → relevance; `NoAuthoritativeItems` ≠ empty relevance. | WS-L3 / WS-D1 / WS-D3 / WS-D4; CF-008 resolution |
| **shape endorsement** | A deterministic Validator raising an `external` value validated against a closed schema declared in the sealed definition to `environment`; free text never. | WS-L3 / WS-H2 / WS-G1; Fides (ℓ, ν), CaMeL Q-LLM |
| **evidence class** | The weight of an item as *evidence* for verification (deterministic vs judged detector; reconciled vs claimed); orthogonal to authority class. | WS-L3 / WS-A2 / WS-G2; prevents CF-080 conflation |
| **unverified** | The bottom authority class for imported, lifted, migrated, attestation-failed or ABI-unvouched content; never coerced into `external`; stratified in analyses. | WS-L3; T-LCD-07 |
| **attestation** | A kernel-verified fact about origin `{kind ∈ {seal, hash_chain, signature, pin}, subject_hash, anchor, verified_by, verified_at}`; authority is derived from verified origin, never from an item's own claim. | WS-L3 / WS-H5 / WS-H6; in-toto/SLSA, A2A JWS |
| **Permission.holder** (rename) | WS-A3's `Permission.principal` field — the AgentProcess that holds a grant. | CF-076 |
